MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: Low volatility environment (Vol: 18.2%) with broad participation (Breadth: 6/8 sectors positive). Market tone is bullish and momentum-driven.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy & Chemicals ABOVE TREND: TRALT (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +14.82%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND. Holding & Investment ABOVE TREND: KCHOL (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ABOVE TREND; SAHOL (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +8.21%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom BELOW TREND: KONTR (1W: -2.76% | 1M: -22.60%) BELOW TREND. Transportation BELOW TREND: THYAO (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.69%) BELOW TREND; PGSUS (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -7.43%) BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TRALT (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +14.82%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +14.75% | 1M: +8.01%) ABOVE TREND; SOKM (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND; EKGYO (1W: +11.34% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND; GUBRF (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.44%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
AEFES (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND; THYAO (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.69%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -13.38%) BELOW TREND; CCOLA (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.40%) BELOW TREND; KRDMD (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +7.11%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
High-momentum movers: TRALT (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +14.82%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +14.75% | 1M: +8.01%) ABOVE TREND; SOKM (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND; EKGYO (1W: +11.34% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking is constructive and ABOVE TREND overall: AKBNK (1W: +6.03% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND; GARAN (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +4.44%) ABOVE TREND; ISCTR (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -2.55%) RECOVERY; YKBNK (1W: +4.58% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed across industrials with selective strength: ASELS (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND; FROTO (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +1.39%) ABOVE TREND; EREGL (1W: +0.63% | 1M: -11.78%) RECOVERY; ARCLK (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy is leading the market and ABOVE TREND with clear breadth: TUPRS (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +8.62% | 1M: -5.54%) RECOVERY; TRALT (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +14.82%) ABOVE TREND; SASA (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -13.38%) BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Overweight cyclical winners (Energy & Chemicals, Holding & Investment, selective Retail) and trim exposure to lagging Tech/Transportation. Maintain liquidity buffer to rotate into momentum breakouts and lock gains on names in CORRECTION.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TUPRS (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND for margin/earnings sensitivity; TRALT (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +14.82%) ABOVE TREND for continued momentum; KCHOL (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ABOVE TREND as a holding conglomerate beta; AKBNK (1W: +6.03% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND for financial flows.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals for earnings and oil-driven flows; Holding & Investment for index leadership and rotation into large caps; Banking for liquidity-driven upside and macro sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 for follow-through above this week’s highs and defend the 20-day MA for the bull trend to hold; catalysts are domestic CPI and CBRT commentary, USD/TRY moves, oil prices and Tupras refining margins, and select August earnings updates.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low-volatility RISK-ON market with broad participation led by Energy & Chemicals, Holding names and select Retail beats. Opportunities: momentum names (TRALT, TRMET, TUPRS, SOKM) and bank/holding rotation; risks: tech and transportation underperformance and any adverse USD/TRY or CPI surprise.
